mainEntity.name: How much does interior door painting usually cost, and what changes the price?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to paint an interior door usually depends on the door type, condition, and whether prep or trim is included. Flat doors are simpler, while paneled, French, or damaged doors take more time and materials. If you have several doors in one home, the per-door cost is often better than doing them one at a time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Interior door painting is usually priced by door type and prep level. Paneled, French, or damaged doors cost more, while multiple doors at once often lower the per-door price.
